written.headline: Scott Bessent urges Nvidia leadership shakeup and answers on China chip sales
written.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called for a dramatic leadership shakeup at Nvidia following the ouster of CEO Jensen Huang. Bessent demanded answers within 10 days on whether Nvidia pushed seemingly illicit chip sales to China to boost revenue.
